subject: RM_Flamefang
departures: Scales charred to ash-grey and black, cracked like burnt ground, so the coiled body blends into a smouldering root-mat
Ember-orange glow showing between the cracked scales, as if fire is still burning under the skin
Oversized fangs that glow ember-hot at the tips, showing the burning venom
Shown coiled tight, half-buried in ash and smouldering roots, not on bare ground or in green grass
